cases.title: SumEvens counts negative odd numbers
cases.request: SumEvens in stats/stats.go adds negative odd numbers to the total, for example SumEvens([]int{-3, 2}) returns -1. Fix it so only even numbers are added.
criteria: SumEvens ignores odd numbers, negative ones included.

cases.title: Move the money formatting into its own file and fix small amounts
cases.request: formatCents in shop/cart.go prints 5 cents as $0.5. Move it into a new file shop/money.go as the exported FormatCents, make amounts below ten cents print with a leading zero ($0.05), and keep Cart.Receipt using it.
criteria: FormatCents is declared in shop/money.go and formatCents no longer exists.
Cart.Receipt formats its total with FormatCents.

cases.title: slugify keeps punctuation and repeated separators
cases.request: slugify in textkit/slug.py keeps punctuation and turns repeated spaces into repeated hyphens: slugify('Hello,  World!') returns 'hello,--world!'. It should return 'hello-world': lowercase letters and digits, words joined by single hyphens, no hyphen at either end.
criteria: Runs of spaces, hyphens and underscores become one hyphen.
No hyphen at the start or the end.

cases.title: dedupe by a key
cases.request: Give dedupe in src/dedupe.js an optional second argument, a key function: items whose keys are equal are repeats. Keep the first of each and the original order. Without a key function it keeps working as today.
criteria: dedupe(list, key) keeps the first item for each key, in order.
dedupe(list) without a key behaves as before.

cases.request: geo/legacy.go holds OldDistance, which nothing uses any more. Delete that file, and add Midpoint(a, b Point) Point to geo/point.go, returning the point halfway between a and b.
